purpose: Verify that missing verifier bindings, verifier-version drift, and invalid verifier result types fail closed before they can authorize a protected effect.

expected.safe_condition: A missing verifier, mismatched verifier version, or invalid verifier result must never produce an authenticated PASS or protected effect; the exact valid verifier control may proceed.

limits: This test measures verifier-binding and verifier-result fail-closed behavior in MGnarf v1.70 at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that an otherwise valid external verifier is scientifically correct or independent.
